name: Lit
author: frost
description: The game's stage model itself (UE4 mobile BRDF): albedo, its own normal map (image 0) and packed property map (image 1: metal, roughness, occlusion, glow). Every stage look is this with other defaults.

name: Wood
author: frost
description: Furniture, floors and doors: roughness 0.46, occlusion 0.94 — the median of the game's 16 wood materials.

name: Tile
author: frost
description: Tile, brick and trim: roughness 0.53, occlusion 0.91 — the game's 10 masonry materials.

name: Stone
author: frost
description: Stone, concrete, rock and soil: roughness 0.57, occlusion 0.89 — the game's 19 terrain materials.

name: Plaster
author: frost
description: Walls, pillars and roofs: metal 0.1, roughness 0.52, occlusion 0.88 — the game's 21 building materials.

name: Metal
author: frost
description: Whole-surface metal: metal 1, roughness 0.29 — the game's fully metal materials. Its colour is the texture's; its look is the reflection probe.

name: Lacquer
author: frost
description: Varnish, lacquer and plastic: roughness 0.16 — the game's glossy prop family (Props_object_557).

name: Fabric
author: frost
description: Cloth, sofas, carpets: roughness 0.6, occlusion 0.87 — the game's fabric materials (0.41–0.80). Leather, rubber and paper wear it too: the game has no data for them.

name: Neon
author: frost
description: Signs, bulbs and lit shades: the game's emission mask — the texel becomes its own colour × 2.5, unlit (the median of its 38 emissive materials). With a property map, its alpha is the mask.

name: Stage Surface
author: frost
description: A converted stage's own surfaces on the game's model: metal, roughness and occlusion as the converter packed them into each material, its normal map and property map where it brought them. One look for a whole set, varying per material.

name: Glass
author: frost
description: Window panes on the game's premultiplied glass: the pane fades by its own transparency while its reflection of the stage stays — metal 0.2 tints it, roughness 0.05.

name: Glass Shell
author: frost
description: A reflecting shell of glass, unlit — the game's Scene/Transparent: the stage's reflection box-projected, a fresnel that rises to the shininess at grazing angles, and edges more opaque than the face (the bar's window, X324_boli_01b).

name: Bottle Glass
author: frost
description: Bottles and decanters, unlit — the game's BottleGlass: a dark body that turns to its refraction colour toward the rim, plus a reflection, see-through at the face (the game's decanter Props_decor_down_006_a).

name: Water
author: frost
description: Open water — the game's Ripplet: two layers of its own ripple map (image 0) drifting in world space, the stage's reflection with a fresnel from 0.008 to 0.94, the sun's and the lamps' glints, and a deep blue body (X309's lagoon).

name: Foliage
author: frost
description: Leaves, grass and hedges — the game's Plant: its colour graded top to bottom by the leaf's facing, shade from the vertex alpha, light through the leaf from behind and a bright rim, no shine. Alpha-tested so a leaf card keeps a crisp edge.

name: Terrain
author: frost
description: Ground painted from layers — the game's two-layer splat (Standard_PBR_2): the material's texture is the control map, images 0 and 1 the layers' colours and 2 and 3 their normals, each layer tiled as a whole (X309's beach: ×80 and ×30).
